aloomannu.name: Aloo Mannu
aloomannu.description: The local message and wake layer for coding agents. Aloo Mannu routes asks, replies and updates between agent sessions on your own machine and keeps one clear record of open asks.

cats_stage.story: Named after two cats at home: one calls out ("ow ow"), and the other answers ("meh") and comes over.

kns: Files and hooks on one machine
Zero cloud relays or remote servers
aloomannu.how_title: Local asks, replies and one clear record of open asks.
aloomannu.how_sub: Aloo Mannu links coding agent sessions on your own computer through plain files and tool hooks, with no cloud relay and no model calls.
aloomannu.panel_note: In private lab use today, running locally on Python's standard library with zero external dependencies and no cloud account.
steps: Send an addressed ask or update
Write a structured message from one coding agent session to another on your computer.
Deliver through local hooks
Tool hooks surface pending messages cleanly in the receiving session without cloud polling.
Close every open ask
Open asks stay visible locally until a matching reply closes them.
aloomannu.rules_title: Standard library, zero network, zero model calls.
aloomannu.rules_sub: Aloo Mannu keeps agent coordination small, deterministic and inspectable on disk.
rules: Runs locally with zero third-party runtime packages.
No cloud relay and no model calls
Message routing happens entirely through local files and hooks.
In private lab use pending public release.

what_it_is.tagline: The local message and wake layer for coding agents on your machine.
